notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Chromatic Orrery.
Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have an infinite amount of {C}, you may use it to activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability.
